status: Partially fixed — source repair and sealed runner publication verified; lifecycle authority follow-up remains
area: Task claim takeover / retained WIP authority lifecycle
finding: A released claim can retain a fresh heartbeat for durable WIP provenance, but takeover previously checked heartbeat expiry alone. After a takeover it wrote claim.state=taken_over without the normal claim lane, admission ticket, session, or direction lock, so downstream consumers treated the successor as non-live while retained WIP still named the predecessor.
expectedBehavior: Claim authority is one canonical state-plus-TTL fact: only an active, unexpired claim is live. Takeover is an append-only transition event that creates the same active claim bundle as ordinary claim acquisition, then removes superseded retained-WIP ownership only after successor authority is durable.
evidenceOrRepro: 2026-08-14 ATM-GOV-0363: repair-claim left a released/taken_over provenance record with a fresh heartbeat, frozen next --claim returned ATM_CLAIM_FOREIGN_UNSTAGED_WIP, and takeover produced running/taken_over without lane metadata. Source-first regression then showed the repaired path yields running/active with minted lane, admission ticket, active work session, direction lock, and no stale wipOwnership.
